sections.label: الخطة
sections.text: موضوع الشراء Environmental & Social (E&S) Specialist . ملخص الشراء : The consulting services (“the Services”) include the responsibilities to ensure that all grant activities comply with national environmental and social laws and the World Bank’s Environmental and Social Framework (ESF). The E&S Specialist will play a key role in integrating sustainability, stakeholder engagement, and risk mitigation into project planning and execution.
